noun_definition: mweb refers to the mobile web version of the Expensify application where users can submit expenses and view details such as the merchant field.
Expense refers to a submitted financial transaction within the mWeb application that includes a description and is associated with a merchant field where a URL should be displayed.
url refers to the long web address that is pasted in the description field of an expense submission, which the user expects to see fully displayed in the merchant field after the expense is paid.
Merchant field refers to the section in the expense record where the full URL should be displayed after the expense is paid, but is currently shown in a truncated form with dots.
